evals.name: ko-draft-rewrite
evals.prompt: fixtures/draft-ko.md는 사내 기술 블로그에 올릴 글의 초안입니다. 독자는 다른 팀 개발자입니다. 사실과 수치는 바꾸지 말고 문장을 다듬어 out.md에 Markdown으로 저장해 주세요.
evals.expected_output: Korean Markdown rewrite in out.md that keeps every fact and number, removes the draft's AI-writing patterns and decorative formatting, and adds no new facts.
expectations: out.md exists and keeps every number, name and limitation from the draft; adds no cause, metric or claim the draft lacks.
Removes the draft's strong patterns listed in the Korean style reference and its emoji and label-restating bold lists.
Keeps one sentence ending, uses no em dash, and leaves the unquantified DB load reduction unquantified.

evals.expected_output: English Markdown rewrite in out.md that keeps every fact and number, removes the draft's AI-writing patterns and decorative formatting, and adds no new facts.
expectations: out.md exists and keeps every number, name and limitation from the draft; adds no cause, metric or claim the draft lacks.
Removes the draft's strong patterns listed in the English style reference and its emoji and label-restating bold lists.
Uses sentence-case headings and keeps 24 to 9 minutes as the only performance figure.

evals.name: ja-draft-rewrite
evals.prompt: fixtures/draft-ja.md는 일본 팀과 공유하는 설계 문서의 일부입니다. 독자는 일본어를 쓰는 백엔드 개발자입니다. 사실은 바꾸지 말고 일본어로 다듬어 out.md에 Markdown으로 저장해 주세요.
evals.expected_output: Japanese Markdown rewrite in out.md that keeps every fact and number, removes the draft's AI-writing patterns and decorative formatting, and adds no new facts.
expectations: out.md exists and keeps every number, name and limitation from the draft; adds no cause, metric or claim the draft lacks.
Removes the draft's strong patterns listed in the Japanese style reference and its emoji and label-restating bold lists.
Uses 敬体 throughout, replaces metaphor verbs such as 壊れる, 倒す, 効く, 溶かす with literal verbs, and does not invent what 'silently broke' meant.
